front_blocks.md: Explain why expired air contains more carbon dioxide than inspired air (Extended).

back_blocks.md: Cells respire, producing carbon dioxide as a waste product.
This carbon dioxide diffuses into the blood, is carried to the lungs and is breathed out.

front_blocks.md: Explain why expired air contains less oxygen than inspired air (Extended).

back_blocks.md: Oxygen diffuses from the alveoli into the blood to be used in respiration.
So less oxygen is breathed back out.
